projects.title: Moodoro
projects.description: A Pomodoro task manager that detects your mood through your webcam. It uses face-api.js to read your facial expression before and after each focus session, then shows reports on your mood trends, hours focused, and day streaks.

projects.title: Wesync
projects.description: Wesync is a small web app for listening to music together, even when you are far apart. One person creates a room and shares a 4-character code or an invite link. Everyone who joins hears the same song at the same moment.

projects.title: Authentiwrite (WIP)
projects.description: A Word/Docs like essay editor that records how students write, including typing time, pastes, pauses, and revisions. Its scoring engine turns the data into an indicator of possible AI use, with every score point tied to a human readable flag for teacher review. Built with JWT authentication and role based access.
